svg.title: WashFlow final sprint isolated schema
svg.desc: 33 application tables, 340 columns and 71 foreign keys captured from a new disposable PostgreSQL database. Preserved demo not migrated. Each arrow points from child to referenced parent; hover for the complete foreign-key definition.
